fields.value: Monitor and budget spend on remote model APIs alongside machine rental

Etude's dollar limits count machine rental only. After EXP-70, an experiment can play a hosted model, and that spend is budgeted by the author on the API key, outside Etude.

Outcome: Etude can show what an experiment has spent on remote model APIs and hold it to a limit, as a second cost axis beside machines.

Jack Heart, 2026-11-14: "it doesn't seem like a bad idea to also be able to monitor and add budgeting on a remote LLM basis in addition to machines. I think those two cost axes probably cover a lot. I don't know that it covers everything. I might say that that's a follow-up to the follow-up". It comes after EXP-70, which comes after the 0.4.1 release. Until then: "for external services ... you do your own budgeting on the API keys for now".

Reference: Manabot's Haiku run (experiments/haiku-mtg183.md) read OpenRouter's reported cost per call and stopped at $2 a game and $50 a campaign, checked before each hosted decision; the report calls these "launch/decision stop thresholds, not hard billing caps". It spent $37.08 on 33,477 decisions.

Open: how the author's code reports per-call cost to Etude; whether the limit sits on the experiment beside the rental limit or is a separate one; what Etude does when the limit is reached mid-game; whether the axis is "remote model APIs" or any metered outside service.
